sloka: अद्यैव च परित्यक्तं वायुना जगदायुषा ।अद्यैव ते निरुच्छ्वासाः काष्ठकुड्योपमाः स्थिताः ।। ७.३५.६२ ॥
transliteration: adyaiva ca parityaktaṁ vāyunā jagadāyuṣā ।adyaiva te nirucchvāsāḥ kāṣṭhakuḍyopamāḥ sthitāḥ ।। 7.35.62 ॥

translations.english: Just today, the life-giver of the world, Vayu, has abandoned them, and just today, they remain breathless, like inanimate wooden walls.
